usedFor: Zendesk Support holds tickets and customers, and HubSpot receives a deal from them through “Create Deal”.

bestTemplate.name: “Ticket Is Created” in Zendesk Support, then “Create Deal” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: A new ticket can open a deal for sales to follow.

watchOut: “New Ticket Created or Updated” fires on updates too, so the same ticket can create a second deal.
